scope: Separate pretrained Apple Vision OCR plus deterministic lexical GUI grounding controls; no native model or browser-action claim

development.status: exposed; all use is development only
development.reproduction: Original 6-by-4 CLIP grid and center control; expected old results 0/24 hits and 1/24 grid point coverage
development.selection: Compare exactly four registered (OCR mode, lexical scorer) configurations across preserved v2 whole-image and v3 fixed-tiling runs; highest development hits, ties prefer whole-image then token_f1. No further interventions before fresh confirmation.

ocr.proposals: Fixed1024x1024 tiles with128px overlap cover the entire image, without instruction or annotation guidance; project word/line boxes back into original pixel coordinates, then use unchanged deduplication

pre_measurement_amendment: Accurate CPU-only Vision failed twice on a generated Continue fixture with TextRecognition.CRImageReaderError error 1. Fast CPU-only revision3 succeeded. Switched to fast before any development or fresh OCR benchmark evaluation; preserve setup-failure report.

ranking.token_f1: 2*token intersection size / (query token count + proposal token count)
ranking.idf_coverage: Within-screen inverse-frequency weighted query coverage times (0.75 + 0.25*proposal token precision)
ranking.normalization: Lowercase alphanumeric tokens, remove terminal s on words >4 characters except ss, fixed instruction stopword set in source
ranking.abstention: No proposals or no positive lexical overlap
ranking.tie_break: OCR confidence, fewer proposal tokens, top then left; no label-dependent choice
ranking.point: Center of the selected OCR box

confirmation.selection: SHA256 rank with prefix mmso-screen-v2-confirmation: over source ID; application/type quotas; exclude all development screen filenames and content hashes, deduplicate confirmation screen identities/hashes
confirmation.run_policy: One final evaluation after selecting among these four development configurations and committing nomination; original64-case manifest remains unseen by evaluation.

metrics: complete per-case pipeline p50/p95 including OCR/process startup and preprocessing
limitations: No paid API, no microphone/private-screen capture, no browser execution
Apple OCR weights are OS-bundled and not independently downloadable/pinnable; record OS build, Vision revision, source and binary hash
Balanced custom subset is not a full ScreenSpot-Pro leaderboard result
Icons without visible text may have no OCR proposal or lexical evidence

previous_attempt.diagnosis: Small visible labels absent from whole-frame OCR; proposal coverage remains bottleneck
